test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

I am being tortured by you.

options.text: I am not being tortured by you.

solution:
The correct answer is "**You are torturing me.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice sentences have the subject performing the action while passive voice sentences have the subject receiving the action.
 
• To convert a passive sentence to active, we need to make the subject the doer of the action.
 
• The subject and the object of the given sentence is 'I' and "you" respectively. 
 
• To make it active, we need to make "you" the subject and "torturing" the action verb.
 
• We will use the present continuous tense to maintain the original tense of the sentence.
 
• Thus, the sentence in active voice will be: 
 
 
• ​You are torturing me.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Incorrect. This sentence is in the present perfect tense and does not maintain the original tense of the given sentence.
 
• Option 2: Incorrect. This sentence is in the negative form and does not express the meaning of the given sentence.
 
• Option 3: Incorrect. This sentence is in the present continuous tense but the subject and object are reversed, making it passive voice.
